data.name: Gilles
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old French word gisil, meaning pledge, hostage, or servant. In medieval Europe, the name was often given to children born to noble families as a sign of good faith in a treaty or agreement. Gilles de Rais, a 15th-century French nobleman and military leader, was the most famous bearer of this name.
